title: Geometry-Aware Langevin Sampling for Matrix-Valued Graph Learning
summary: Bayesian inference over positive semidefinite (PSD) matrix-valued parameters arises in structured covariance estimation, graph-Laplacian precision models, and multi-output graph learning, but Euclidean proposals often mix poorly near the cone boundary. We propose \ConeMALA, a geometry-aware Metropolis-adjusted Langevin algorithm whose proposal geometry is induced by the model's log-determinant structure.
